mobile.safety.report.description: The platform reviews the report. The author does not learn who you are.
mobile.safety.report.followUp: You will receive an acknowledgement, then the decision, in your notifications and under “My data and appeals”.
mobile.safety.report.noteTooLong: The details exceed the allowed length.
mobile.safety.report.alsoBlockUnnamed: Also block this person after the report
mobile.safety.report.sent: Report sent. This content is hidden for you; the acknowledgement arrives in your notifications.
mobile.safety.report.already: You had already reported this content. Follow it under “My data and appeals”.
mobile.safety.report.failed: The report could not be sent.
mobile.safety.block.title: Block {{name}}?
mobile.safety.block.consequence: The link is cut both ways and in every network: no more messages, no more invitations, no more following each other, nothing of one reaches the other. Blocking is silent — the person is not told.
mobile.safety.block.reversibility: The block can be lifted, but neither the broken connection nor the removed follows come back by themselves: you have to invite or follow again.
mobile.safety.block.listHint: You will find this block under Settings › Blocked people, to lift it.
mobile.safety.block.failed: The block could not be saved.
mobile.safety.block.reportedNotBlocked: Report sent, but the block could not be saved. You can block again.
mobile.safety.unblock.title: Unblock {{name}}?
mobile.safety.unblock.body: The block you set will be removed across all your ANTSIA networks. No connection or follow is restored.
mobile.safety.unblock.failed: The block could not be removed.
mobile.safety.blocked.title: Blocked people
mobile.safety.blocked.scope: These blocks apply across all your ANTSIA networks. Unblocking restores neither the connection nor the follows removed when blocking.
mobile.safety.blocked.unavailable: Your blocks could not be loaded.
mobile.safety.blocked.atLeast: At least {{count}} blocks: the list continues.
mobile.safety.profile.blockedByMe: You blocked this person. Their profile stays closed while the block lasts.
mobile.safety.conversation.blocked: You blocked {{name}}. The conversation stays closed while the block lasts.
mobile.safety.conversation.blockedUnname: You blocked this person. The conversation stays closed while the block lasts.
mobile.safety.errors.refused: This action is not possible for this content.
mobile.safety.errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait before trying again.
mobile.safety.errors.unavailable: The action did not complete. Check the connection, then try again.
mobile.safety.help.title: Help, contact and rules
mobile.safety.help.lead: Report content or block a person from the content itself. For any other request, the network’s publisher answers at the address given in the legal notice.
mobile.safety.account.title: Account
mobile.safety.account.lead: Delete your account from the app, with 30 days to cancel.
mobile.safety.erasure.title: Delete my account
mobile.safety.erasure.lead: Erasure of your social data is scheduled after a 30-day cancellation period. Retained quotations become anonymous. Commitments and transaction copies held by professionals follow a separate process.
mobile.safety.erasure.sessions: As soon as you request it, all your sessions are closed, on this phone and elsewhere.
mobile.safety.erasure.cancelWindow: During these 30 days, you can cancel by signing in again: Settings › Delete my account, or “My data” on the website.
mobile.safety.erasure.commerce: ANTSIA erasure does not cancel or refund appointments, orders or payments. It does not confirm erasure of copies held by PRO.GA or professionals. Retention of invoices, evidence and other transaction data follows a separate process whose rules remain to be validated.
mobile.safety.erasure.bookings: Upcoming appointments with professionals: {{count}}. Erasing your account does not cancel them on their side; cancel them first from My requests.
mobile.safety.erasure.bookingsMany: You have at least {{count}} upcoming appointments with professionals. Erasing your account does not cancel them on their side; cancel them first from My requests.
mobile.safety.erasure.bookingsUnknown: The number of upcoming appointments is unknown. An unavailable read does not mean there are none. Review your requests and commitments before deciding.
mobile.safety.erasure.bookingsNone: No upcoming appointment was identified in the requests reviewed. This count does not cover your orders or payments.
mobile.safety.erasure.bookingsEmptyWindo: No upcoming appointment was identified in the reviewed window. Other requests may not be covered.
mobile.safety.erasure.openRequests: Open My requests on the website
mobile.safety.erasure.failed: This operation did not complete. You can try again.
mobile.safety.erasure.requestedLead: Your erasure request is recorded. You can cancel it until that date.
mobile.safety.erasure.cannotCancel: Erasure has started: the request can no longer be cancelled.
mobile.safety.erasure.demo: Demo accounts are shared: deleting them is not offered here.
mobile.safety.erasure.signedOut: Your erasure request is recorded and your sessions are closed. Erasure is scheduled for {{date}}; you can cancel it until then by signing in again.
